test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.**

Time and technology are two important factor that change substances into resources.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is- 'factor that'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in part 'factor that' of the sentence.
 
• The use of the adjective** "two"** before the subject** "important factor" **shows that the subject "important factor" must be plural.
 
• So, the plural form of **"factor"** is **"factors."***​​*
 
• ​​To make the sentence grammatically correct, we must substitute "factor that" with "factors that."
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

Correct sentence__: *Time and technology are two important __**factors that**__ change substances into resources.*
